+# Controller Apply focus correction (CF1)
+
+The P01 Controller Settings change checked focus ownership after disabling the active Apply button and hiding its editor. Native disabling can move focus to the document body, causing the new guard to suppress the existing return to **Edit controller settings**.
+
+The original public v0.57.1 interface sample recorded only `activeElement.id === ""`. Controller action buttons have no IDs, including Edit, so this did **not** prove the browser focused the body. Cancel already explicitly focuses Edit. The concrete Apply condition was identified in the source and reproduced with a more faithful fixture; the public sample remains an unknown focus target.
+
+[Controller Settings](../../../../game/ui/controller-settings.mjs) now captures ownership before disabling controls. Temporary observers relinquish restoration after later focus, pointer or keyboard intent, page visibility changes, or window blur. Successful Apply restores the same enabled Edit node only while its transaction is current, its container is connected, the document is visible and focused, and focus remains owned or empty. Observers are removed on abort and settlement.
+
+Canonical validation, single-flight Apply, guarded host adoption, persistence warnings, Cancel, source-change invalidation, refresh and disposal semantics are preserved. The correction neither commits a draft early nor reclaims focus from another modal or a later user choice.
+
+The [test fixture](../../../../game/test/controller-settings.test.mjs) now focuses actions and models blur when an active control is disabled or hidden. With the public runtime unchanged, the existing canonical Apply focus assertion failed: **16/17 passed**. The original failure is retained in the [controlled-before receipt](loading-placement/controller-focus/native-blur-before.json) and [log](loading-placement/controller-focus/native-blur-before.log).
+
+After the correction, this focused command passed **85/85**, with zero failures, cancellations, skips or todos:
+
+```text
+node --test game/test/controller-settings.test.mjs game/test/controller-navigation.test.mjs
+```
+
+The tests cover successful restoration, deliberate focus followed by blur, body pointer input, keyboard navigation, hidden/returned pages, window blur, missing initial ownership, refresh, changed source and disposal. Targeted ESLint and Prettier checks passed. The [correction receipt](loading-placement/controller-focus/receipt.json), [focused result](loading-placement/controller-focus/focused.json) and [log](loading-placement/controller-focus/focused.log) preserve exact commands, source hashes and evidence boundaries.
+
+The [native correction review](loading-placement/craft-final/run/review.md) confirms the corrected behavior at 844×390 with Large/Plain/Reduced preferences. After keyboard Apply, the active element is the enabled Edit button, its action is `edit`, `:focus` matches, and the 47-pixel target is clear. The next native Tab reaches the visible Boost-mode selector. Reopening retains the applied Xbox setting; changing the draft to PlayStation and cancelling restores Edit focus, and reopening still shows Xbox. The original unsuccessful pointer activation is retained separately from the subsequent successful keyboard action.
+
+This is candidate-source browser evidence. The original public sample's unknown focus target remains unknown; these results do not establish exact-source release qualification, corrected public behavior or P01 acceptance.

+# P01 craft preparation inside Missions
+
+The [public v0.57.1 interface review](loading-placement/public-interface/review.json) found that Flight setup starts real craft loading, but its `craft-preparation-status` belongs to the background arena. At 1280×800, native preparation showed “Loading craft and scene artwork…” at y777.48–797.78 while the top-layer Missions dialog covered it. Hit testing reached the deploy bar. The owned page was visible and focused; this observation is separate from the earlier excluded hidden-page attempt. Preparation reached ready without a data error.
+
+The correction moves the same status element into a full-width row inside the existing sticky Missions heading. It covers normal mission selection and direct briefing, without depending on the hidden mission-content or deploy-bar regions. An empty/ready row collapses; errors remain readable. Actual close and disposal restore the original position; a queued old close leaves the current modal's status intact. The host presenter, renderer's load-token guards, focus, flight state and nonblocking cosmetic policy remain unchanged.
+
+The first focused actual-host navigation/renderer batch passed 59 tests, including two new placement/lifecycle cases. Existing delayed image and stale renderer completion tests remain unchanged. The first native correction trial then exposed an overlap at both 390×844 and 844×390 with Large/Plain/Reduced text: the separate sticky status and existing sticky heading both used top zero, and the heading covered the loading label. The first enabled setup selector remained unobstructed. These were actual transient status/hit-test observations; no painted busy frame is claimed.
+
+The revised layout puts heading and feedback in one sticky box instead of competing layers. Its native review confirmed the label and Back action in all four Standard/Large portrait/landscape cells, but exposed another problem: the expanded heading covered the top of the focused Pack selector in Large portrait, and the bottom action bar covered its lower edge in Large landscape. Bounds inside the viewport alone had not detected either overlap. That failed trial is retained in the [evidence index](loading-placement/copies.json).
+
+The final correction measures the heading's lower edge and the action bar's upper edge. `attachFocusClearance` adjusts scrolling only enough to expose the current enabled control between them, without moving focus or reacting to ordinary wheel/touch scrolling. It reads current focus when the scheduled layout callback runs, ignores hidden/closed/disposed hosts, and keeps a tall control's beginning visible. Both Missions entry paths use the same helper.
+
+Nine recorded-geometry cases and the existing actual-host navigation/renderer tests pass together: 68 tests, zero failures. An independent source review found no concrete blocker. These tests establish ownership and geometry behavior, not painted-browser visibility.
+
+The [final native correction review](loading-placement/craft-final/run/review.md) passes all four Standard/Large portrait/landscape cells. The focused Pack selector, loading label and Back each pass center and four interior hit tests. Large landscape and portrait screenshots paint the actual loading state; Standard preparation finished before its later captures. Direct briefing shows real loading in portrait and the collapsed ready state in landscape. All 227 foreground guards passed, and 16 runtime/source pins remained unchanged through browser closure. The original filenames and failed/inconclusive attempts are preserved.
+
+The browser's later animation-frame and timer callbacks were delayed despite visible/focused guards; craft preparation eventually cleared. The report retains that timing uncertainty and the full 250-entry resource buffer's limits, without attributing a cause or changing runtime timing. These observations do not establish physical-device or performance qualification. The valid Library foreground checks from the [earlier craft trial](loading-placement/foreground/run/review.json) remain separate. Exact-source qualification and release are still required; P01 is not accepted by this source change.

+# P01 Library operation visibility correction
+
+The public v0.57.0 Library export completed but left feedback offscreen. The same Library modules, style and HTML fragment were preserved in v0.57.1. At 390×844, its active status began at y1689 after a visible Export action; at 844×390 it began at y945 and Cancel was above the viewport. These are original native DOM observations; the short busy interval was not captured as a painted screenshot. The [retained reproduction](../../../../publishing/pages-controller/delivery/evidence/cross-mode-p01/library-placement-v057/reproduction.md) includes terminal screenshots, completed exports and the excluded capacity-limited first attempt.
+
+The correction adds a sticky operation area to the existing Library dialog. It moves the exact status and applicable Cancel nodes, preserving IDs, handlers, live announcements, disabled state and operation ownership. Full detail remains keyboard-scrollable. Closing restores exact sibling positions. Showing the same owner is idempotent and preserves focus; reopening a still-running detached task remounts its current status. A cancelled backup read retains its existing lock until settlement, and its cleanup can clear only its own presentation.
+
+Save validation, durable commits, import/Undo, attempt source checks and downloads remain under their existing owners. The area creates no second task, presenter, store or cancellation policy. An ordinary Cancel retains its terminal message. Navigation clears that message when the relevant pending read has settled.
+
+## Verification status
+
+The actual source candidate initially passed 51 focused tests covering attempt export, backup-set host and profile transfer. The 24 attempt-export cases include the original 17 unchanged test bodies and seven placement/focus/stale-close cases; the cache-only negative control failed against the unchanged Library implementation as expected. The test DOM now models connected parent nodes, sibling order and blur after removal. Geometry remains modeled in these tests.
+
+The broader host batch recorded 102 passes and three failures in 105 cases. All three failures came from the Gallery fixture: its local adapter tracked `parent`, while inherited node movement used `parentNode`, and the Library status had no parent. The fixture now connects the Library nodes and uses the same parent relationship for both APIs. All 41 Gallery tests pass after that correction. Every original Gallery and attempt-export test body remains byte-identical; runtime code and assertions were unchanged by this fixture correction. The failed batch is retained separately from the successful focused retest.
+
+The first native correction trial exposed another required defect: at 844×390 with Large/Plain text, the sticky result occupied y33.75–225.75 and covered the focused Export button at y171.42–218.42. Native hit testing reached the status text instead of the button. The corrected helper measures the actual lower edge after layout and scrolls the current focused control clear without changing focus or ownership. Independent review also caught the 170-pixel textarea case; the downward adjustment is now bounded so the editor's beginning cannot be moved back under feedback. The focused export/Gallery suite passes 69 tests, including the recorded geometry, closed/current-focus guards, Close and tall editor cases. A first new Close fixture check failed because its button lacked the real HTML's `data-close` attribute; that fixture correction and initial failure are retained.
+
+The final candidate's clean native Large landscape trial keeps Export at y288.42–335.42 below the operation area's y225.75 lower edge; all four corners and its centre hit the original control. PageDown reaches the full detail, rotation preserves visible focus, and 90 frames after a manual wheel retain the user's scroll position. Later observations from that trial remain provisional because an unexpected About Chrome tab hid the owned page; its cause is not established. Those original limits remain in the [R3 report](loading-placement/r3/run/review.json).
+
+The [fresh foreground follow-up](loading-placement/foreground/run/review.json) closes the portrait gap on candidate 0.57.2: PageDown reaches scrollTop 25 for 363 pixels of text in a 338-pixel region; both message and label have equal client/scroll widths, without horizontal overflow. Native Close is 44 pixels and unobstructed. Escape returns focus to the Settings trigger, restores the original status parent and clears the area on reopening. The run's 125 before/after foreground checks stayed visible and focused with no unexpected page. Its separate craft obstruction is retained as a required failure, not merged into the Library pass. The final focused Library suite comprises 28 attempt-export and 41 Gallery cases.
+
+This document does not yet establish an exact-source corrective release, its public play or completed P01. The new patch must pass the existing six gates, build/production/integrity checks and public release cycle. The earlier v0.57.0 and v0.57.1 artifacts remain immutable. v0.57.1's separate offline correction has its own accepted public evidence and does not qualify this Library change.
+
+[The copy manifest](loading-placement/copies.json) preserves the intermediate native trials, focused checks and original public interface review byte-for-byte. Their original source/version, failures and evidence categories remain explicit.
+
+Review follows the [loading contract](../../../presentation-loading.md), [Xbox UI navigation](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/xbox/accessibility/xbox-accessibility-guidelines/112), [visible focus](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/xbox/accessibility/xbox-accessibility-guidelines/113) and [W3C status messages](https://www.w3.org/WAI/WCAG22/Understanding/status-messages.html). Source recommendations, modeled state tests, browser measurements and physical devices remain distinct evidence.
